niche: Larkmoor County's pre-plea diversion pilot, offered by monthly lottery from June 2025 because the provider had places for half the eligible defendants, read at the 31 August 2026 cut for the provider's 2027 contract renewal, when most offered defendants are still inside the twelve-month programme and a terminated case goes back to the trial calendar for months
answer: renew the agreement for 2027 at the pilot's scale (a cut of 18 percentage points)
analyst_test: A strong analyst who reads every field and the Board's resolution correctly analyses the lottery as randomised and reads each arm's cumulative incidence of conviction at the longest follow-up, a cut of 31 points that renews at full scale (the recorded shares, 36 points, file the same tier); open offered cases convict only after terminations the program has not yet made, so only completing them through the program's month-by-month termination chance, its final review included, and the terminated cases' own conviction rate files 18 points and renewal at the pilot's scale.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is the diversion lottery's effect on the share of eligible defendants eventually convicted in the referred case, read the way criminal justice evaluation reads a diversion offer (everyone offered against everyone not offered) through the stages pre-plea diversion creates; with another field's nouns the deferred prosecution, the termination that returns a case to the trial calendar and the conviction that follows it stop making sense.

driver: A lottery's effect on a final outcome that offered units reach only by failing a fixed-length deferral stage, after which the outcome follows on a slow calendar, so at the cut most offered units are still inside the stage; the outcome as recorded, a cumulative incidence read to the longest follow-up, or the failures so far taken as final each count pending units as non-outcomes, and only each pending unit's chance of failing in its remaining stage months, from the stage's own month-by-month hazard, times the outcome rate failed units reach gives the effect.
driver_concrete: Each offered defendant whose case is open on 31 August 2026 completed through the program's termination chance by program month to the end of the twelve-month term, the final review included (23 per cent of those who reach it), and the conviction rate terminated cases reach on the stipulated record (91 per cent against 56 for cases never offered), giving a cut of 18 points and renewal at the pilot's scale rather than the 31 points the arms' recorded curves give.
stump: A competent analyst analyses the lottery as randomised, reads each arm's cumulative incidence of conviction at the longest follow-up and renews at full scale on a cut of 31 points (the recorded shares give 36); the offer defers its own outcome, since a participant is convicted only after the program terminates them and a terminated case is then tried on the stipulated record months later, and the program terminates almost a quarter of those who reach its final review, so only completing every open offered case through the program's month-by-month termination chance, the final review included, and the conviction rate terminated cases reach files a cut of 18 points and renewal at the pilot's scale.

differentiation.task133: task133 conditions a filed cumulative default curve on each loan's survival to date to price a forward loss allowance; this reads a lottery's effect, the offered arm completed through the deferral stage's own month-by-month termination hazard rebuilt from the provider's monthly records and the conviction rate terminated cases reach back on the trial calendar, with no filed curve and a contrast against the arm never offered

lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-23 at stage 4 on Gate F: the isolated scored reader fitted a Makeham-Weibull survivor curve to the plant ledger's balances, rebuilt each pre-1987 vintage's survivors from its additions and committed the golden 33,000 (asks 14 of 19)
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is how many units in service are at least a given age when many units' start dates were never recorded and are missing more often the older the unit; the units still in service from each start year are that year's intake times the chance of lasting to its present age, a curve fitted to the yearly outflow of the unrecorded group, so the unrecorded units are spread over start years by what that leaves once the recorded ones are taken out, not like the recorded ones and not in proportion to intake.
lineage.driver_concrete: How many of Kestrin Valley Electric Cooperative's distribution poles on the 30 September 2026 register were set in 1977 or earlier, with the poles that have no year of setting spread over the pre-1987 years as each year's additions times a survivor curve fitted to the ledger's year-end balances from 1938 to 2025, less the poles of that year whose brand was read; not spread like the poles whose year is known, not in proportion to additions, and not on a curve whose shape cannot follow the ledger.
lineage.stump: A competent analyst who parses every brand and reads every account spreads the poles with no year of setting like the poles whose year is known, or in proportion to each year's additions, and files a count of poles 50 or older thousands off; brands fade with age, so the poles with no year are the oldest, and each year's survivors are its additions thinned by decades of retirements that climb after forty years, so only a survivor curve fitted to the ledger's balances, applied to each year's additions, says how many poles of each age are still standing.
lineage.niche: a rural electric cooperative's 2027 full groundline inspection, sized by how many of its wood poles will be 50 or older, when about one pole in nine in service carries no year of setting

lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-23 at stage 4 on Gate F: both isolated scored readers placed every result under its analyzer's last calibration from the UTC event log, took each calibration's ratio from the December re-assays anchored at the October check and committed the golden four counties; the slot's objective was then exhausted and on 2026-11-01 the author re-tasked the number to experiment-causal
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is which groups of a weighted population have more than a share below a line on a reference scale, when one check measured the instrument's bias under one calibration and a random subsample was measured again in one later run; the bias is set at each calibration, which changes more often than the labelled batch, so shifts pooled by batch leave the groups measured under calibrations far from their batch's average on the wrong side of the line, and only each reading's own calibration's shift, anchored at the calibration the check ran under, names the set.
lineage.driver_concrete: Which of eight counties had more than 30 per cent of adults with 2025 examination serum 25-hydroxyvitamin D below 20 ng/mL on the reference measurement procedure's scale: each result divided by the bias of the calibration it was measured under, that calibration's shift read from the December re-assays of stored duplicate aliquots of results measured under it and anchored at the calibration the October accuracy check ran under; not the reported results, not the check's bias on every result, not the re-assay shifts pooled by reagent lot and analyzer.
lineage.stump: A competent analyst pools the December re-assays by reagent lot and analyzer, adds the October accuracy check for the lot and analyzer it measured and names the wrong counties, or divides every result by the check's bias and names fewer; the calibrator lot changed on its own dates and every recalibration moved the assay's bias, so only each result's own calibration's shift, read from the re-assays of results measured under it and anchored at the check's own calibration, names the golden set.
lineage.niche: a health district examination survey's 2025 wave, used to choose the counties where the district's 2027 vitamin D programme opens first (more than 30 per cent of adults below 20 ng/mL on the reference method's scale), when one accuracy check measured the laboratory's immunoassay under one calibration and the survey's December re-assays of stored duplicate aliquots, run under one later calibration, are the only link from it to every other calibration of the year
